name: Digital Footprint
source:
Himari is invited to a cabin getaway with her crush, Koyomi, and a few of her friends - Rio, Nanase, and Honoka. Here's hoping this trip goes well... and maybe, her and Koyomi will grow closer along the way...!

[From [url=https://hollisgray.itch.io/digital-footprint]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阳葵受邀与暗恋对象历，以及莉央、七濑和穗乃果几位好友一同前往林间木屋度假。但愿这趟旅行一切顺利……说不定在旅途中，她还能和历拉近彼此的距离呢……！

[摘自[url=https://hollisgray.itch.io/digital-footprint]itch.io[/url]]
